doc.title: Kristen Korb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000

title: Goodbyes
summary: Rowe hopes to see her in New York; thanks.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well best of luck to you, and I’ll kind of look for you in New York in the future too.
We’re fairly close to there and hope it goes well.
